The set of all points $(x,y)$ that are a distance of $25$ units from the origin defines a circle with radius $r=25$ centered at the origin, as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13956996/assets/d526d47989c735bcdd8629b76246c3bd88d4b3a142bcdffb33ea8bc0c51cb31e.png)

So, the required equation is

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & ={r}^{2} \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & ={25}^{2} \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & =625.\end{aligned}
$$
